text:
mira: heads up — kv-shard-prod-11 hit an OOM this morning after ~24h. looks like steady residency growth rather than a single spike. attaching brief stats: residency 1.0G -> 1.6G in 20h, slab_frag 12%->35%.

otto: any recent traffic shape changes?

mira: we enabled bulk-write path for sync jobs two deploys ago. suspect builds up mid-size objects.

kai: ok let's do a two-track plan: short term guardrails + deep profiling. short term: soft cap at 1.5G with 10% canary, drop batcher.max_bulk=16 -> 8 on canary. deep track: reproduce in staging with bulk workload, collect heap diffs and slab histograms.

mira: owners? i'll own the rollout, kai will own profiling. otto can help review allocator probe.

ops-bot: queued: apply soft_residency_limit=1536MB -> canary 10% at 05:30 UTC by mira. alerts: `kv.residency.delta > 120MB/1h`, `kv.errors > 0.3%`.

kai: repro command i'll run on staging: `./tools/stress_kv --mode=bulk --concurrency=150 --item-size=24k --duration=8h`. will collect `perf`, `heapdiff` every 20m and slab histograms.

mira: rollout plan: canary 10% for 30m, expand to 50% if no errors, full after 2h. rollback triggers: error rate > 1% or p95 latency > 300ms. document in runbook.

otto: i'll put a small allocator probe patch that emits `slab_alloc_tag` and per-bucket counts, will ask review from kai.

kai: expected artifacts by EOD tomorrow. long-term ideas: background slab compaction, per-key residency quotas, and eager eviction for bulk-written prefixes. we'll prioritize after data.

mira: decision: short-term soft cap + batcher rollback on canary, profiling run, allocator probe. owners: mira(ops), kai(profiling), otto(alloc probe). target: triage & fix list in 5 days. :white_check_mark:
